message.content: The AI RMF (Framework) could support the privacy discussion in this dissertation by providing a common language and understanding of AI risks, as well as ensuring that the privacy aspects of the AI RMF are easily communicated and can be adapted to fit the needs of different organizations and stakeholders. It could also ensure that the privacy aspects are regularly updated and transparently managed, allowing for contributions from various stakeholders. Additionally, the AI RMF could provide clear and understandable terms and definitions of AI risks, ensuring that the privacy discussion is relevant and useful to practitioners.
